name: let-him-cook
description: Home-local Codex plugin for Wix internal engineering workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Let Him Cook: read-only Wix engineering workflows for Codex
interface.longDescription: Let Him Cook is a home-local Codex plugin for Wix engineering chores. It adds readiness checks, read-only governance, local runtime artifacts, and peer-reviewed workflows for build triage, investigations, research, and planning.
defaultPrompt: Investigate this failing Wix PR build with DevEx and Octocode.
Research the internal pattern for this Wix service or API.
Summarize the incident evidence and get peer review before concluding.
